app_type: hybrid_fullstack (Data-Dense SaaS CRM & Bank Marketing Dashboard)

branding.logo_concept: House silhouette created by an emerald green roofline with a metallic gold upward-trending arrow integrated within, symbolising property growth and financial intelligence
branding.theme_mode: Clean light mode with rich dark slate structural elements and high contrast gold/emerald accents

spacing_and_layout.grid_dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6
spacing_and_layout.crm_pipeline_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4 overflow-x-auto pb-4

key_components_to_build.app_header: Top header with PROPERLEAD Logo & Wordmark, Wilayah Filter dropdown, Search lead input, In-App Notification Bell with count badge & alert drawer, and User Profile Dropdown (Super Admin / Marketing User role switcher)
key_components_to_build.sidebar_navigation: Sticky Dark Slate sidebar (#0F172A) with items: Ringkasan Dashboard, Pipeline CRM, Daftar Lead, Proyek & Tata Ruang, Notifikasi & Alert, Manajemen User (Admin Only), and Settings
key_components_to_build.stat_cards: 4 primary stat metrics: 1. Lead Baru Hari Ini (Count + trend), 2. KKPR Terbit (Blue accent), 3. RDTR Baru (Green accent), 4. Status Berubah (Orange accent)
key_components_to_build.leads_data_table: Interactive lead list with filtering by Wilayah (Banjarmasin, Banjarbaru, Kab. Banjar, Tanah Laut, Barito Kuala, dll) & Jenis Proyek (Perumahan Subsidi, Commercial, Kluster Mewah, Ruko). Features priority badges A/B/C, score pill (0-100), OSS milestone tag, developer name, and quick follow-up trigger button
key_components_to_build.lead_detail_modal: Comprehensive detail view showcasing developer profile, project location map, Tata Ruang (RDTR / Zona detail), Perizinan (KKPR / PKKPR number & date), Lead Score breakdown, Activity Timeline, and CRM status action buttons
key_components_to_build.crm_kanban_board: Interactive 6-stage drag/move CRM pipeline: NEW → SUDAH DIHUBUNGI → RESPON → MEETING → PROPOSAL → KERJASAMA with lead value estimate, developer contact, and quick status update
key_components_to_build.notifications_drawer: Real-time alert list filtering by RDTR Baru (Hijau), KKPR Terbit (Biru), and Perubahan Status (Oranye) with direct click to open lead detail
key_components_to_build.super_admin_user_panel: User management tab allowing Super Admin to assign roles (Super Admin vs Marketing User), edit target regions, track follow-up metrics per agent, and manage system access

project_previews.description: Aerial view of residential housing project in Banjarbaru
High angle view of commercial & housing lot development in Banjarmasin

avatars.description: Bank Marketing Executive - Super Admin Avatar

motion_and_interactions.kanban_drag_animation: framer-motion layout transition for continuous smooth position updates
motion_and_interactions.notification_pulse: animate-ping for unread high-priority RDTR/KKPR alerts

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, filter dropdowns, badges, and modal dialogs MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='filter-wilayah-select', data-testid='lead-card-1', data-testid='follow-up-button-modal', data-testid='crm-stage-meeting-column')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: Ensure high contrast on text overlays (min 4.5:1 ratio). All alert badge text MUST be explicitly dark against tinted backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Lucide React icons for system icons (e.g. Building2, FileCheck2, MapPin, Bell, ShieldCheck, UserCheck, PhoneCall, TrendingUp, Filter, Search).
Ensure all text is in professional Indonesian suitable for a banking/finance executive environment.
Support dual role simulation (Super Admin & Marketing User) via a quick-switch toggle in the top header so reviewers can test both views seamlessly.
Implement mock interactive functionalities: Lead filtering by region/type, Lead Score breakdown modal, CRM pipeline stage updates, and in-app alert dismiss/read actions.
All interactive elements must include 'data-testid' attributes.
